title: 第19章 她不适合我第20章 最终名单
content_zh:
;;
“这灵魂等级，应该就是《武道概论》中提及的精神力。”方羽暗道：“若非精神力暴涨，我想短短一个多月刀法入微，几乎不可能。”
“难怪高级武者们，技艺普遍都强。”
高级武者，普遍技艺水准更高，他们修炼多年，大半都能达到入微大成的地步。
难道是因他们悟性更高？
不！是因为强大武者的精神力更强、基础更强。
强大的身体，孕育出更强大的精神力，对身体筋骨、气血感应更清晰……掌控身体入微自然更容易。
如同初中生学习知识，普遍要比小学生更快些，并非小学生天赋差，而是孩童大脑还在发育。
技艺修炼，同理。
身体越强，精神力越强，技艺提升会更容易……技艺高了，也会令生命层次提升更快，两者相辅相成。
这也是蓝月联盟，如此重视虚空星相的缘故。
觉醒强大虚空星相的武者，能不借助资源宝物，光吸收星力就能成高级武者……能大大节省整个文明的资源。
方羽早就发现。
伴随生命层次的提升，自己的灵魂也在飞速蜕变……虽然未刻意锻炼精神力，但灵魂等级，一直要比生命层次高出好几级。
这一个月来。
方羽心无旁骛在家苦修，除指点弟弟妹妹，便是练拳练刀，竟在不知不觉中就令刀法入微。
刀法入微！
乃是身心器合一，是许多高级武者修炼多年都求不得的。
“古代的那些大宗师，身体素质明明就和我现在相当，技艺却能达到传说中天人合一的地步，当真不可思议。”方羽心中感慨。
若是古代那些大宗师，放在当今时代，给一定时间，恐怕都能成星空武者吧。

“刀法入微，生命层次20级，这保送名额。”
“怎么都该有我一个。”方羽很有信心，哪怕又真冒出一两个厉害学生，按理也不影响，毕竟有十个名额。
……
时间流逝。
王墨很快也进入考核场地。
他显露出的进步速度，也令二楼的武道老师们颇为惊讶。
“这个王墨，技艺竟然入微？”
“筋骨齐鸣，入微小成。”
“生命层次竟然也达到20级，有钱，生命层次提升起来还真快，估计他们家花费也不小。”这些老师颇为唏嘘。
“老严，这下，你可抢了两个名额。”
“我们就惨了。”其他老师纷纷开玩笑道。
20级的生命层次，放在大专生中，非常罕见。
content_en:
;;
"This soul level should be the mental power mentioned in "Introduction to Martial Arts"." Fang Yu secretly said: "If the mental power hadn't skyrocketed, I think it would be almost impossible to master the subtlety of swordsmanship in just over a month."
"No wonder senior warriors are generally very skilled."
Senior warriors generally have a higher level of skill. After practicing for many years, most of them can reach the level of mastery.
Is it because they have higher understanding?
No! It's because powerful warriors have stronger mental strength and stronger foundation.
A strong body breeds stronger mental power, and can sense the body's muscles, bones, and qi and blood more clearly... It is easier to control the body in every detail.
Just like junior high school students generally learn knowledge faster than primary school students, it is not that primary school students are less talented, but that children's brains are still developing.
The same goes for skill training.
The stronger the body and the stronger the mental power, the easier it will be to improve skills... The higher the skills, the faster the level of life will be improved, and the two complement each other.
This is also the reason why the Blue Moon Alliance attaches so much importance to the void astrology.
A warrior who has awakened the powerful void star can become a high-level warrior by simply absorbing star power without resorting to resource treasures... which can greatly save the resources of the entire civilization.
Fang Yu had discovered it long ago.
As his life level increases, his soul is also transforming rapidly... Although he has not deliberately trained his mental power, his soul level has always been several levels higher than his life level.
This month.
Fang Yu was focused on practicing hard at home. In addition to giving advice to his younger brothers and sisters, he also practiced boxing and swordsmanship, and he unknowingly perfected his swordsmanship.
Excellent knife skills!
It is the integration of body, mind, and weapons, which many high-level warriors cannot achieve after years of practice.
"Those great masters in ancient times had the same physical fitness as me now, but their skills could reach the legendary level of harmony between heaven and man. It's really incredible." Fang Yu sighed in his heart.
If those great masters in ancient times were to be considered in today's era, given a certain amount of time, they would probably become star warriors.
"Excellent swordsmanship, life level 20, this guaranteed spot."
"I should be the one anyway." Fang Yu was very confident. Even if one or two powerful students emerged, it would not be affected. After all, there were ten places.
…
Time passes.
Wang Mo soon entered the assessment venue.
The speed of progress he showed also surprised the martial arts teachers on the second floor.
"This Wang Mo, his skills are so exquisite?"
"The muscles and bones sing together, and you achieve perfection in small steps."
"The life level has actually reached level 20. If you have money, your life level can rise really fast. I guess their family's expenses are not small." These teachers were quite sad.
"Old Yan, now you have grabbed two places."
"We are in trouble." Other teachers joked.
A life level of level 20 is very rare among college students.
